name: Clip Health
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; Fremont, CA, USA
long_description: At Clip Health, we are relentlessly executing on the vision to enable accessible, personalized, and actionable health testing, with immediate follow-up, across infectious, metabolic, endocrine, and chronic diseases and conditions. The Clip Platform brings our proprietary glow-in-the-dark nanochemistry in combination with connected easy-to-use hardware and delightful-to-use mobile apps to at-home, point-of-care, and enterprise settings.
one_liner: Testing & treatment at home, in minutes, for chronic & acute disease

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Now: 
1. arden.bio/service - precision R&D service for unresolved chronic immune-disorder patients
2. tempusirb.com - fast (same-day IRB reviews for research/clinical trials) 

2014 to 2023, I was cofounder/CEO of Clip Health (YCS16), a Khosla Ventures and NIH-funded startup. Raised $54M, built a HW/bio/chem rapid diagnostics platform, launched 1st product that shipped >1m units but failed to parlay into sustainable growth. Pre-2014 I got a PhD in bio/chem engg (microfluidics/bacterial dx).

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio:
I'm a scientist and engineer at heart. I love any and all things science from fundamental physics to chemistry and materials science to biology. My passion in life is to help drive scientific and technological progress by shepherding innovative technologies based on hard science and engineering out of the R&D lab and onto the commercial marketplace.

I have 12+ years of experience working at the intersection of biology, chemistry, nanotech, hardware, and software.
